differences.current_text: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.
differences.source_text: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.

differences.current_text: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.
differences.source_text: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

differences.current_text: What one nation in the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?
differences.source_text: What one nation on the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?

differences.current_text: Then The LORD commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.
differences.source_text: Then the LORD commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

differences.current_text: Yours, LORD, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, LORD, and you are exalted as head above all.
